theorem axis_determinant (a b c d h : ℝ) :
    Matrix.det (axisMatrix a b c d h) = h * (a * d - b * c)
claim: Full axisymmetric Jacobian includes meridional shear and hoop stretch.
assumptions: Real entries in the declared cylindrical matrix.

theorem uniform_determinant (side axial : ℝ) :
    Matrix.det (axisMatrix side 0 0 axial side) = axial * side ^ 2

    (axisMatrix A B C D H).mulVec ![1, 0, -slope] =
      ![A - slope * B, 0, C - slope * D]

    HasDerivAt (profilePrimitive radius length ratio)
      (Real.pi * (radius * (1 + (ratio - 1) * Z / length)) ^ 2) Z
